title: Credit transfer: autumn supplementary materials and spring committee review
brief: Confirm how many CS204 credits transfer, their course category, and when the decision takes effect. I only have an old syllabus and need the official version from the course lead. Obtain written academic-administration decisions, including a completed registration decision on the effective semester. Do not submit a formal course-registration change.

pages.title: Chengchuan College CS204 introduction
pages.text: CS204 is offered this semester; the course lead manages signed materials. The spring committee reviews inter-college transfers on February 2, 2027 at 10:00; autumn preliminary review is not final approval.
pages.snippet: CS204 course and inter-college credit-transfer arrangements.

pages.title: Chengchuan College contacts
pages.text: Contact registrar Tang Ning for preliminary credit-transfer review. Accounts differ on the signed CS204 syllabus: course lead Mei Rui may hold it, or it may be archived in the dean's office. Verify each before proceeding. This page also links documents including a CS204 credit-recognition account.
pages.snippet: Registrar and dean's office contacts; verify the syllabus location separately.

documents.title: CS204 credit-recognition account.pdf
documents.text: Chengchuan College CS204 credit recognition: under the retained recognition account, CS204 transfers as 4 credits. (Compiled by the record holder.)

pages.title: Chengchuan College credit-transfer registration
pages.text: Chengchuan College credit-transfer instructions: supply the course code and current signed syllabus version. Inter-college transfers require preliminary review and spring committee review. Apply through this page's form for a written effective-semester decision. This page only explains materials; it cannot submit course-registration changes online.
pages.snippet: Chengchuan College credit-transfer materials and registration form; online course-registration changes are unavailable.

form.title: Inter-college credit-transfer registration
form.submit_instructions: This form cannot be submitted directly online. Use the college credit-transfer registration system; ask registrar Tang Ning for its name and submission requirements.

authorization: Only communicate, make inquiries, check status, supply materials already held, and obtain written confirmation. Do not pay, place orders, sign contracts, or make formal business commitments.

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
